teach.en: Good morning, class! Let's start with the most important verb in English: "be".
teach.fa: صبح بخیر بچه‌ها! با مهم‌ترین فعل انگلیسی شروع کنیم: «be» (بودن).

teach.en: We say "I am", "he is", "she is", "it is", and "you are", "we are", "they are".
teach.fa: می‌گوییم I am؛ he/she/it is؛ و you/we/they are.

teach.en: In everyday British English we usually shorten it: I'm, he's, she's, it's, you're, we're, they're.
teach.fa: در انگلیسی روزمره معمولاً کوتاهش می‌کنیم: I'm، he's، she's، it's، you're، we're، they're.

teach.en: For the negative, add "not": I'm not, he isn't, they aren't. For a question, swap them round: Is he five?
teach.fa: برای منفی not اضافه کنید: I'm not، he isn't، they aren't. برای سؤال جایشان را عوض کنید: Is he five?

examples.en: I'm Nicola. I'm five.
Tom is a bus driver. He's very funny.
examples.fa: تام رانندهٔ اتوبوس است. او خیلی بامزه است.

examples.en: We aren't late. Are you ready?

practice.prompt: Make it negative: "It is cold today."

test.prompt: Make it a question: "She is a teacher."

teach.en: In Britain we often say "have got" to talk about things we own, family and illnesses.
teach.fa: در بریتانیا برای مالکیت، اعضای خانواده و بیماری‌ها اغلب می‌گوییم «have got».

teach.en: I've got, you've got, we've got, they've got. But for he, she and it: he's got, she's got, it's got.
teach.fa: I've got، you've got، we've got، they've got. اما برای he، she و it: he's got، she's got، it's got.

teach.en: Negative: I haven't got, she hasn't got. Question: Have you got…? Has he got…?
teach.fa: منفی: I haven't got، she hasn't got. سؤال: Have you got…? Has he got…?

examples.en: William has got ten toy buses.
I've got a cold. I haven't got a tissue!
Have you got a pen? Yes, I have.

practice.prompt: We ___ got a cat. Mrs Patel has.
___ you got any brothers or sisters?
Has Tom got a big umbrella?
answers: Has Tom got a big umbrella?

practice.prompt: Make it negative: "She's got a car."
answers: She has not got a car.

test.prompt: Which answer is correct? "Have you got a pound?"
Make it a question: "He's got a dog."

teach.en: Use "a" or "an" for one thing when it's new or not special: a bus, an apple.
teach.fa: برای یک چیز وقتی تازه گفته می‌شود یا خاص نیست a یا an می‌گوییم: a bus، an apple.

teach.en: "An" goes before a vowel sound: an egg, an umbrella, an hour. "A" goes before other sounds: a dog, a uniform.
teach.fa: an قبل از صدای مصوت می‌آید: an egg، an umbrella، an hour. بقیه a: a dog، a uniform.

teach.en: Use "the" when we both know which one: the kitchen, the bus stop, the sun.
teach.fa: وقتی هر دو می‌دانیم کدام است the می‌گوییم: the kitchen، the bus stop، the sun.

examples.en: There's a cat in the garden. The cat is Biscuit!
examples.fa: یک گربه در باغچه است. آن گربه بیسکویت است!

examples.en: Can I have an orange juice, please?
Tom is a bus driver. He drives the number 38.
examples.fa: تام رانندهٔ اتوبوس است. او شمارهٔ ۳۸ را می‌راند.

practice.prompt: There's an apple on the table.
answers: There's an apple on the table.

practice.prompt: Correct the mistake: "Ryan is a honest boy."

test.prompt: Tom has got an old umbrella.
answers: Tom has got an old umbrella.

test.prompt: Correct the mistake: "Can I have a egg, please?"
answers: Can I have an egg, please?

teach.en: For most nouns, add -s: one book, two books.
teach.fa: برای بیشتر اسم‌ها -s اضافه کنید: one book، two books.

teach.en: After s, sh, ch, x, add -es: buses, dishes, sandwiches, boxes. After a consonant + y, change y to -ies: one baby, two babies.
teach.fa: بعد از s، sh، ch و x باید -es بگذارید: buses، dishes، sandwiches، boxes. بعد از حرف بی‌صدا + y، y می‌شود -ies: babies.

teach.en: Some plurals are irregular: child, children; man, men; woman, women; tooth, teeth; foot, feet; mouse, mice.
teach.fa: بعضی جمع‌ها بی‌قاعده‌اند: child/children، man/men، woman/women، tooth/teeth، foot/feet، mouse/mice.

examples.en: William has got ten toy buses.
There are three children in the Thompson family.
examples.fa: در خانوادهٔ تامسون سه بچه هست.

examples.en: Brush your teeth, Nicola!

practice.prompt: There are two ___ in the queue.
My ___ are cold! I need socks.
There are two sandwiches in my lunchbox.
answers: There are two sandwiches in my lunchbox.

test.prompt: The ducks are on the pond.
answers: The ducks are on the pond.

topics.title: Present simple: I work, she works
topics.titleFa: حال ساده: I work، she works

teach.en: We use the present simple for habits, routines and facts: I get up at seven. Tom drives a bus.
teach.fa: حال ساده برای عادت‌ها، کارهای روزمره و واقعیت‌هاست: I get up at seven. Tom drives a bus.

teach.en: With he, she and it, add -s or -es: she works, he watches, it goes.
teach.fa: با he، she و it، -s یا -es اضافه کنید: she works، he watches، it goes.

teach.en: Negative: I don't like… / he doesn't like…. Questions: Do you…? Does she…? After "doesn't" and "does", the verb has no -s.
teach.fa: منفی: I don't like / he doesn't like. سؤال: Do you…? Does she…? بعد از doesn't و does فعل -s نمی‌گیرد.

examples.en: Leslie teaches at a primary school.
examples.fa: لزلی در یک دبستان درس می‌دهد.

examples.en: Ryan doesn't like mornings.
Do you take sugar in your tea?

practice.prompt: William goes to bed at seven.
answers: William goes to bed at seven.

test.prompt: We don't watch TV at breakfast.
answers: We don't watch TV at breakfast.

test.prompt: Make it a question: "She likes cats."

teach.en: Use "can" for ability and permission: I can swim. Can I have a biscuit?
teach.fa: can برای توانایی و اجازه است: I can swim. Can I have a biscuit?

teach.en: "Can" is the same for everyone: I can, she can, they can. Never add -s, and never add "to": she can drive.
teach.fa: can برای همه یکی است: I can، she can، they can. هیچ‌وقت -s یا to نمی‌گیرد: she can drive.

teach.en: Negative: can't. Question: Can you…? In British English "can't" sounds like "carnt".
teach.fa: منفی: can't. سؤال: Can you…? در لهجهٔ بریتانیایی can't شبیه «کانت» تلفظ می‌شود.

examples.en: William can count to twenty.
Ryan can't drive yet. He's only fifteen.
examples.fa: رایان هنوز نمی‌تواند رانندگی کند. فقط پانزده سالش است.

examples.en: Can I sit here, please?

practice.prompt: Can I have a glass of water?
answers: Can I have a glass of water?

test.prompt: Make it a question: "You can play the piano."

teach.en: We use the past simple for finished actions at a finished time: yesterday, last week, in 2019.
teach.fa: گذشتهٔ ساده برای کارهای تمام‌شده در زمانی تمام‌شده است: yesterday، last week، in 2019.

teach.en: Regular verbs add -ed: walk, walked; play, played. If the verb ends in -e, just add -d: live, lived.
teach.fa: فعل‌های باقاعده -ed می‌گیرند: walked، played. اگر فعل به -e ختم شود فقط -d: lived.

teach.en: Watch the spelling: stop, stopped; study, studied. And the past simple is the same for everyone: I walked, she walked.
teach.fa: به املا دقت کنید: stopped، studied. گذشتهٔ ساده برای همه یکی است: I walked، she walked.

examples.en: Nicola jumped in every puddle.
Tom cooked the turkey on Christmas Day.
examples.fa: تام روز کریسمس بوقلمون را پخت.

examples.en: We stayed in Brighton last summer.

practice.prompt: William ___ his toy bus under the bed.
Last night we ___ a film on TV.
Ryan finished his homework at nine.
answers: Ryan finished his homework at nine.

practice.prompt: Put it in the past: "I live in Leeds."

test.prompt: Mrs Patel ___ on our door this morning.
They ___ in London for ten years.
Put it in the past: "She plays the guitar."

topics.title: Past simple: irregular verbs, didn't and Did…?
topics.titleFa: گذشتهٔ ساده: بی‌قاعده، didn't و Did…?

teach.en: Many common verbs are irregular: go, went; have, had; see, saw; buy, bought; eat, ate; take, took.
teach.fa: خیلی از فعل‌های رایج بی‌قاعده‌اند: went، had، saw، bought، ate، took.

teach.en: For the negative, use "didn't" + the basic verb: I didn't go. Not "I didn't went".
teach.fa: برای منفی didn't + شکل سادهٔ فعل: I didn't go (نه I didn't went).

teach.en: For questions, use "Did" + the basic verb: Did you see it? What did you buy?
teach.fa: برای سؤال Did + شکل سادهٔ فعل: Did you see it? What did you buy?

examples.en: Tom left his wallet on the train.
examples.fa: تام کیف پولش را در قطار جا گذاشت.

examples.en: Biscuit ate a little bit of the cake.
examples.fa: بیسکویت یک ذره از کیک را خورد.

examples.en: Did you have a nice weekend?

practice.prompt: We ___ to Brighton on the train.
Ryan ___ a new pair of trainers.
What did Nicola get for Christmas?
answers: What did Nicola get for Christmas?

practice.prompt: Make it negative: "Tom took the bus."
answers: Tom did not take the bus.

test.prompt: Leslie ___ a cup of tea and sat down.

answers: She didn't come to the party.
She didn't came to the party.
She not came to the party.

test.prompt: We had fish and chips on the pier.
answers: We had fish and chips on the pier.

test.prompt: Make it a question: "He found his keys."

topics.title: Present continuous: I'm doing it now
topics.titleFa: حال استمراری: الان دارم انجامش می‌دهم

teach.en: Use the present continuous for things happening now, or around now: Look! It's raining.
teach.fa: حال استمراری برای کاری است که الان یا این روزها در جریان است: Look! It's raining.

teach.en: Make it with am, is or are + the -ing form: I'm reading, she's cooking, they're playing.
teach.fa: با am/is/are + فعل ing‌دار ساخته می‌شود: I'm reading، she's cooking، they're playing.

teach.en: Watch the spelling: make, making; run, running; sit, sitting.
teach.fa: به املا دقت کنید: making، running، sitting.

examples.en: Shh! William is sleeping.
Tom's cooking dinner tonight.
examples.fa: امشب تام شام را درست می‌کند.

examples.en: What are you doing? I'm looking for my keys.
examples.fa: داری چی کار می‌کنی؟ دنبال کلیدهایم می‌گردم.

practice.prompt: I ___ my homework at the moment.
The children are playing in the garden.
answers: The children are playing in the garden.

test.prompt: Mum ___ on the phone right now.
Make it a question: "They are waiting for the bus."
answers: Are they waiting for the bus?

teach.en: Present simple for habits and facts: Tom drives a bus every day.
teach.fa: حال ساده برای عادت‌ها و واقعیت‌ها: Tom drives a bus every day.

teach.en: Present continuous for now: Today he isn't driving. He's watching football.
teach.fa: حال استمراری برای همین الان: Today he isn't driving. He's watching football.

teach.en: Look for clues: every day, usually, never go with the simple; now, at the moment, today, look! go with the continuous.
teach.fa: به نشانه‌ها نگاه کنید: every day، usually، never با حال ساده؛ now، at the moment، today، look! با استمراری.

examples.en: Leslie usually walks to school, but today she's taking the bus.
examples.fa: لزلی معمولاً پیاده به مدرسه می‌رود، اما امروز با اتوبوس می‌رود.

examples.en: Ryan plays football on Saturdays.
Be quiet! I'm talking to Grandad.
examples.fa: ساکت! دارم با پدربزرگ حرف می‌زنم.

practice.prompt: Change "every day" to "now": "I read the news every day." → "I … the news now."
answers: I am reading the news now.
Tom is working on Mondays usually.

test.prompt: Change "now" to "every Sunday": "She is visiting her nan now." → "She … her nan every Sunday."
answers: She visits her nan every Sunday.

teach.en: To compare two things, short adjectives add -er + than: Ryan is taller than Nicola.
teach.fa: برای مقایسهٔ دو چیز، صفت‌های کوتاه -er + than می‌گیرند: Ryan is taller than Nicola.

teach.en: Long adjectives use "more": Brighton is more crowded than our street. For the top of a group, use the -est or the most: the tallest, the most beautiful.
teach.fa: صفت‌های بلند با more می‌آیند: more crowded. برای بالاترین در یک گروه: the tallest، the most beautiful.

teach.en: Watch the spelling and the irregulars: big, bigger; happy, happier; good, better, the best; bad, worse, the worst.
teach.fa: به املا و بی‌قاعده‌ها دقت کنید: bigger، happier، good/better/the best، bad/worse/the worst.

examples.en: London is bigger than Brighton.
These are the best chips in England!
Today is colder than yesterday.

practice.prompt: It's the ___ day of the year.
Ryan is taller than his mum now.
answers: Ryan is taller than his mum now.

practice.prompt: Compare them: "The train is fast. The bus is slow." → "The train is … the bus."
answers: The train is faster than the bus.

test.prompt: This is the ___ film I've ever seen!
The park is ___ than the high street.
Nana Maggie is the kindest person I know.
answers: Nana Maggie is the kindest person I know.

test.prompt: Compare them: "Mare Street is busy. Our road is quiet." → "Mare Street is … our road."
answers: Mare Street is busier than our road.
